scripts.dev:app: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "ROLE=api WHATSAPP_MODE=simulator pnpm --filter @iasaude/api dev" "NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3001 pnpm --filter @iasaude/web dev"
scripts.staging:db:reset: cd infra/supabase && npx supabase db reset
scripts.staging: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,worker,web --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta "PORT=3001 ROLE=api pnpm --filter @iasaude/api dev:staging" "PORT=3010 ROLE=worker pnpm --filter @iasaude/api dev:staging" "NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3001 pnpm --filter @iasaude/web dev"
